data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word 'zor', meaning 'dawn' or 'radiant'. In the Bible, Zuri is a place name that appears in the book of Joshua. The name Zuri carries the meaning “Radiant, Dawn, Light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Zuri usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, dawn, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
